state.paragraph: On August 7, 2014, a representative of Industry Participant contacted a representative of J.P. Morgan. The Industry Participant representative indicated that she had heard rumors that J.P. Morgan was working with the Company and wanted to inform J.P. Morgan that, if the Company were to pursue strategic alternatives, Industry Participant might be interested in re-visiting the conversations that had taken place in the Spring concerning the feasibility of a possible combination of the two Companies. The J.P. Morgan representative reported the conversation to the ad hoc committee.

ledger_rows.Note: After weak Q1 results (05/21/2014), some stockholders and interested parties urged strategic or financial alternatives, including a levered return of capital and a sale of the Company.
Target legal adviser; first seen acting at 06/18 board meeting, which chose to focus on capital return and formed ad hoc committee (Josefowicz, Gangwal, Stemberg).
Unnamed financial advisor to the board, first seen acting 06/18; board then authorized vetting and retention of a financial advisor. Not mentioned again.
13D at 9.9%; sought review of alternatives including a sale. Further 13D amendments and public letters in July–August advocating a sale; met the Company 07/10/2014 advocating a sale.
Shareholder; public letter urging board to consider a sale; would consider rolling some or all holdings into buyer equity. Met board in May without advocating; reiterated sale advocacy 07/10/2014.
Target’s sole financial adviser, retained after interviews; engagement letter effective 08/21/2014; fee up to about $39 million; gave fairness opinion 12/13/2014.

Privately-held industry competitor; contacted J.P. Morgan after rumours, may revisit spring 2014 talks (PetSmart-initiated merger/acquisition discussions, which IP rebuffed citing antitrust). No price.

Board decided to explore alternatives incl. a sale, with Profit Improvement Plan as standalone fallback; ad hoc committee to oversee; J.P. Morgan outreach deferred to late Sept/early Oct; public announcement planned.

Parties contacted J.P. Morgan (inbound); includes potential lead buyers and large equity suppliers. All 27 reported to board by 10/03. Reasons section: Company “contacted or were contacted by more than 25”.
Inbound contacts to J.P. Morgan, excluding Industry Participant. None signed a confidentiality agreement (all 15 signers were financial).
Press release with Q2 earnings; intended to let parties not contacted approach J.P. Morgan on their own initiative.

Target refused admission: on ad hoc committee direction, J.P. Morgan conveyed concerns (08/22), then said IP not invited (antitrust, information, delay risks); proposals would be considered. Reaffirmed 10/03. No later contact; never entered.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
